## <b>Adult Protective Services</b>

<b>417</b>
total calls

<b>29</b>
total calls afterhours

Allen County’s Adult Protective Services (APS) program
investigates and provides some level of follow-up
service to every referral it receives. Though some calls
are ultimately screened out under the state’s program
guidelines—including 20 referrals regarding out-of-
county residents and 19 referrals of individuals under
the age of 60—it is the goal of our APS team to make
contact on every referral to the program.
